notes: G0 Emergency Override is the only path on which a Mandate transitions to Suspended without an in-band degradation. human_witness MUST be present (§7.4 line 3); RR notification carries highest priority (§EH.3).

post_state.note: G0 is a unilateral override channel orthogonal to G1-G4; the Mandate.grade snapshot is unchanged but the Mandate's status is Suspended.

signature_verification.note: Real Ed25519 signatures over canonical CBOR. WebAuthn human_witness blobs are deterministic placeholders (see README); verifiers MUST treat their bytes as opaque and only validate structural presence.

summary: G0 Emergency Override from G1 → Suspended; HP unilateral channel with mandatory human_witness.
